jobs.description:
Looking for a job where you stay active and earn a great salary? At GXO in Heerlen, you’ll work in a modern warehouse for well-known brands like Zara, H&M, Primark, IKEA, and Ahold. You make sure every order is ready on time.

As a warehouse worker, you keep everything running smoothly:

- Picking orders like clothing and shoes
- Packing items carefully and preparing them for shipment
- Helping to keep stock organized

You’ll work full-time in a 2-shift system (morning and afternoon). The schedule is clear and planned in advance, so you always know what to expect.

- You can speak and read English
- You have your own transport to GXO Heerlen
- You’re available fulltime in 2 shifts
- Experience in logistics is nice, but not required (GXO teach you everything)

Are you a true go-getter with leadership experience in logistics? Do you know how to motivate a team and ensure that everything runs smoothly on the shop floor? Then we’re looking for you!

As a Warehouse Team Leader, you’ll be the first point of contact for your team. You’ll actively participate on the shop floor, manage your colleagues, and ensure that daily logistics processes are carried out safely, efficiently, and according to schedule.

What will you do?
As a Warehouse Team Leader, you will lead a team of approximately 5 to 15 warehouse employees and temporary workers. Together, you make sure all warehouse activities are completed safely, efficiently, and on time.

Your responsibilities include:

- Coordinating daily inbound, storage, order picking, and outbound activities.
- Leading, coaching, and supporting warehouse employees on the work floor.
- Monitoring productivity, quality, and safety standards.
- Ensuring accurate administrative processing in the Warehouse Management System (WMS).
- Reporting operational issues and supporting continuous process improvements.
- Working closely with the Warehouse Supervisor and Customer Service to achieve daily operational targets.
- Helping to create a safe, clean, and organized working environment.

You are a hands-on leader who enjoys working in a fast-paced warehouse environment and knows how to motivate a team.

You also have:

- An MBO Level 3 qualification, preferably in Logistics.
- At least 2 years of experience in a supervisory role within logistics or manufacturing.
- Experience working in a warehouse environment.
- Good communication skills in English (Dutch is an advantage).
- A proactive attitude and strong organizational skills.
- A focus on safety, quality, and teamwork.
- A valid Certificate of Conduct (VOG). If your VOG is approved, Olympia will reimburse the cost of €41.35. If your VOG is not approved, the cost will be at your own expense.
- You have your own accommodation;

About the job

Are you precise, motivated, and do you enjoy working in a clean and well-organized environment? As a Cleanroom Operator, you will make sure that components are carefully cleaned, inspected, and packaged for customers in the high-tech industry.This is a varied position where accuracy, quality, and teamwork are key.

What will you do?

In this role, you will work in a cleanroom environment where precision and quality are essential. You will work with customers from the high-tech, medical, automotive, and aerospace industries — sectors where there is no room for error and where your work directly contributes to the final product.As a Cleanroom Operator, you will play an important role in cleaning, inspecting, and packaging components. You will work according to clear protocols and detailed work instructions.

Your responsibilities include:

- Cleaning components using modern machines or manually
- (Dis)assembling components based on technical drawings
- Performing detailed quality inspections, including inspections using UV lamps
Packaging components in the cleanroom to ensure they arrive at the customer in perfect condition

You will work in a modern, safe, and well-organized environment where teamwork and quality are highly valued.

What are we looking for?

- MBO-level education or equivalent working and thinking level
- Experience in a cleanroom or assembly environment is a plus, but not required — we are happy to train you
- Good command of English; Dutch is a plus
- You work accurately and independently and have a flexible attitude
- You are available to work in shifts: 06:00–15:00 and 15:00–00:00
- You don't meet all the requirements but think this position could be a good fit for you? We would still love to hear from you!

Are you an experienced logistics employee with valid certificates and looking for a new challenge? For one of our clients, we are looking for motivated logistics staff who can work both independently and as part of a team.

Key Responsibilities

- Load, unload and move goods within the Service Centre using a forklift, reach truck, stacker or other transport equipment.
- Receive, store and process incoming goods, including the related administrative tasks.
- Manage internal product movements and maintain accurate inventory levels.
- Ensure product quality while following all safety, environmental and housekeeping procedures.

The job runs in a 2-shift rotation: one week from Monday to Friday, 06:00–15:00, followed by a week from Monday to Friday, 15:00–00:00.

- Proven experience in logistics (required)
- Valid certificate for:
- EPT (Electric Pallet Truck)
- Forklift
- Stacker
- Minimum English level A2 (spoken and written)
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift system
- Accurate, motivated, and reliable
- Able to work both independently and as part of a team

Are you looking for an active warehouse job that fits perfectly with your personal life? Then this is your chance! We are currently looking for motivated order pickers and packers who can start immediately and are available for both morning and afternoon shifts. Using modern tools such as hand scanners and voice picking, you will collect orders quickly and accurately. You make sure every order is complete and ready for shipment.

In this role, you will stay active throughout the day and play an important part in keeping the logistics process running smoothly.

Working hours (2 shift system):

- Morning: 07:00 – 16:00
- Afternoon: 16:00 – 00:00

- You speak English or Dutch
- You are available at least 2 days per week
- You are willing to work in a 2 shift system
- You are physically able to perform active work (standing, walking, lifting)
- No experience is required, motivation are most important
- Resident of the Netherlands
- Valid work permit for the Netherlands required
- No housing available

jobs.occupation: Warehouse Employee at Samsung in Breda (123733003)
jobs.description:
As a logistics employee at Samsung SDS in Breda, you will help get products from Samsung and other companies to the right place. You work in a team where there are regular staff meetings to get to know each other better.

Your tasks depend on the position. Primarily your tasks will be physical, so you need to be physicaly fit. You might be packing and preparing products like microwaves and tv's for shipment. Or you might be loading and unloading containers either with forklift or manually.

You will work two shifts: early (6 a.m. to 3.00 p.m.) or late (3.00 p.m. to 0.00 p.m.).

You will work between 30 and 40 hours per week. 

Do you want to contribute to Samsung's success? Then apply now!

You enjoy working in an international environment and love to work hard. At Samsung SDS, you'll help keep everything running smoothly in the warehouse.

What you bring:

- You have your own transportation to get to work. When you work in shifts, public transport is not possible
- You speak good English, which is helpful in this international environment.
- You are available full-time
- You are fit enough for physical work.
- You have your own accommodation.

It is nice if you are flexible. Sometimes we work overtime or on weekends. But don't worry, that doesn't happen every week!

Conventional Lathe Operator

Conventional turning outdated? Not in our work!
Alongside CNC machining, conventional techniques continue to offer plenty of challenges.

You will perform turning operations on components up to Ø1,500 x 8,000 mm, weights up to 8,000 kg. Most parts are one-offs, requiring precise work, patience, and perseverance. 
First time right is more important than speed.
In addition to conventional turning, knowledge of 3-axis CNC milling is preferred. 
If you don’t have this yet, no problem! You are eager to learn and willing to develop these skills.

We understand that it can take 1 to 2 years for a new colleague to reach the desired level in our field. 

We start with a one-year contract, but aim to convert it to a permanent position as soon as possible.
We work daytime shifts, and a 4-day workweek is available if you prefer.

Requirements 
•    At least a level 3 vocational education (MBO 3) or equivalent; a completed qualification is a plus but not required.
•    Hands-on experience in machining.
•    Practical, solution-oriented, and eager to learn.

Personal qualities
•    Patient and persistent, with a strong work ethic
•    Thinks before starting a task
•    Works in a structured and precise manner, with a clear understanding of the job at hand
•    Able to work independently, but also thrives in a team environment
•    Speaks English 

Examples of jobs
- Compressor rotor
- Double-acting hydraulic cylinder
- Screw compressor housing
